name: it.bikerlink/real
title: BikerLink REAL
description: Motorcycle travel: Punti Biker, Smart Stations, PhotoPass and human-verified services in Italy.

tools.name: bikerlink_search_places
tools.description: Search publicly active Punti Biker and Smart Stations by name, location or code, including GPS coordinates, pass page, public PhotoPass URL and public image_url / hub_graphic_url for displaying the location. When present, verified_data contains published BikerLink services, prices, offers and the verification date. ONLY human_verified:true with verification_label VERIFICATO DA AGENTE UMANO — BIKERLINK REAL indicates an authorized human agent attestation; consult verification_method for on_site versus live_video. Never infer on-site presence from live video.

tools.name: bikerlink_get_place
tools.description: Get public information including image_url and hub_graphic_url for one active Punto Biker or Smart Station by code, e.g. PB-00002 or SS-00002. When present, verified_data contains published BikerLink services, prices, offers and the verification date. ONLY human_verified:true with verification_label VERIFICATO DA AGENTE UMANO — BIKERLINK REAL indicates an authorized human agent attestation; consult verification_method for on_site versus live_video. Never infer on-site presence from live video.

tools.name: bikerlink_photo_pages
tools.description: Find public PhotoPass/photo gallery links associated with active Punti Biker. Includes the public PB image_url and hub_graphic_url; no individual photos, photo availability dates, galleries or purchases are indexed here.

tools.name: bikerlink_search_verified_services
tools.description: Search published BikerLink REAL services and offers from active PB and SS locations, with controlled Italian, English, German and Spanish keyword variants for motorcycle travel. This is keyword/concept matching, not full natural-language AI interpretation. Only records explicitly marked human_verified:true and verification_status:verified_by_human_agent have been attested by an authorized human agent, on-site or via live video (see verification_method). Other records may be confirmed by the manager or by phone. Prices and availability refer to the stated verification date, not real time.

free_only.description: Show only activities with a verified free service/offer matching the requested service

tools.name: bikerlink_geo_search
tools.description: Search BikerLink REAL first-party geographic PB/SS data, optionally near GPS coordinates, BikerLink code, approved Google Street View photo ID or Google Place ID. Returns independently recorded BikerLink service data and approved location reference metadata. Google photo proximity is NEVER human verification; only verified_data.human_verified=true indicates an authorized agent attestation. Not a live availability service. Supports My Maps waypoint-to-BikerLink referrals.
